title: Men's Plush Slippers – Warm with TPR Sole for Indoors & Outdoors
descriptionHtml:
Cold floors win every winter morning

The underfloor heating doesn't reach all the way and socks only help for a while. Your feet are cold before the coffee is even ready.

Slippers lined like a winter jacket

Thick plush all the way around the foot keeps the warmth in, and the TPR sole means you can take the trash out without changing shoes.

Features

  • Your feet stay warm – thick plush lining all around the foot
  • Works on the driveway too – durable TPR sole for indoors and outdoors
  • Nothing to fiddle with – slip-on – straight in first thing in the morning
  • Won't slip on the stairs – patterned sole with grip
  • Cushioned under the heel – memory foam insole that shapes to the foot

Changing your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
